purpose: Proves that a targeted exact_replace which edits content inside an anchored region preserves the data-disco-comment-anchor exactly once — the anchor id survives the edit and is neither dropped nor duplicated.
required_evidence: count of each data-disco-comment-anchor id before and after the edit
before == after == 1 for the edited anchor
rationale: The edit changes only the price text inside the anchored section while keeping data-disco-comment-anchor="pricing-1" present exactly once. Comment anchors map user comments to artifact regions; preserving them 1:1 is mandatory, so the oracle returns pass.
